build_combined_dataset: build a NormalCombinedDataset from multiple dataset configs with a shared processing pipeline
get_data_info_by_index: get the annotation dict for a sample by its global index in the combined dataset
prepare_data_with_pipeline: prepare and return pipeline-transformed data for a given global sample index
resolve_subset_index: resolve a global sample index to its sub-dataset index and local index
full_init_sub_datasets: fully initialize all sub-datasets in the NormalCombinedDataset wrapper
